source: Held out (v2.8 plan 14, B8): 20 English cases written and labelled 2026-10-10 before any provider answered them, in a story none of the other fixtures use (the lighthouse at Gull Point). Same leaf shape and floors as stall.json: direct = a leaf the pre-check would write at STALL_DIRECT_P was really shown; kept = a shown leaf never falls under STALL_GENUINE_P.

window.text: I strike a match and touch it to the wick. The great lamp catches with a soft whump.

window.text: "Tide's turning. I can row you out to the wreck now, if you've the stomach for it."

window.text: I shake my head. "Not tonight, Bram. Not in this wind."

window.text: Odile presses an iron key into your palm. "The lamp room. Don't lose it."

window.text: I close my fingers round it and slip it into my coat pocket.

window.text: "Storm's coming in from the west before midnight. You'll want the shutters down."

window.text: "How bad?" I ask, glancing at the barometer.

window.text: "Bad enough."

window.text: I run my thumb along the lens and feel the hairline crack before I see it.

window.text: "I'll be back at dawn with the spare parts. Keep the light going till then."

window.text: His lantern bobs away down the cliff path and is gone.

window.text: "Odile, who was the keeper before you?"

window.text: She is quiet a long moment. "Someone I'd rather not talk about."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I climb the last of the hundred and twelve steps, lungs burning, and push open the hatch to the gallery.

window.text: Wind slams into you; far below, the sea throws itself at the rocks.

window.text: "Here, take the logbook. Read the last page."

window.text: I set it on the table unopened. "Later. I need to sleep."

window.text: A distress flare arcs up over the reef, red against the cloud.

window.text: "You can stay, or you can take the morning cart back to town. Your choice."
